title: The Dollmaker's Workshop
intro: Rows of unfinished faces watch you from the workbench. The dollmaker never left. The porcelain cabinet at the end of the room holds the way on.

objects.label: Half-Made Doll
objects.reward_text: The half-made doll sits up and screams.

a_eyes: Try assuming the first speaker is a knight and follow what that forces. If you hit a contradiction, they are a knave.
A statement from a knave must be FALSE. Negate it to learn something certain.
The knights are Brynn. The code is B. The vault's character number 1 is 3.
b_limbs: There are 11 stones, so the number of ways to pick any pair is 11 x 10 / 2 = 55.
Count the pairs that give the wanted outcome, then divide by the total number of pairs.
The probability is 3/11. The vault's character number 2 is E.
c_machine: You need exactly (width) steps right and (height) steps up, in some order.
The number of routes is the number of ways to choose which steps are 'right'.
That is C(10, 5), the number of ways to choose 5 items from 10.
The answer is 252. The vault's characters number 3 and 4 are R and S.
vault: The code has four characters. Some are letters, some are digits.
Each solved object revealed part of the code. Check the vault display.
The pieces go in the order they sit on the vault: Glass Eyes, Wooden Limbs, Sewing Machine.
